# Incident response from alert to learning

We need a lightweight incident-response process for a SaaS team. Monitoring sends a high-confidence alert to the alert manager, which groups duplicates and pages the primary on-call engineer. The on-call engineer acknowledges the page, performs an initial triage, and either resolves a false alarm or declares an incident. A declared incident creates a shared incident record and assigns a service owner who investigates and applies mitigation. The on-call engineer coordinates the response and keeps the public status page current while the service owner works.

Mitigation is verified against the same monitoring signals before the incident can be resolved. If verification fails, ownership returns to the service owner for another mitigation attempt. Resolution closes the public update, preserves the timeline in the incident record, and schedules a post-incident review whose actions enter the follow-up tracker. If the primary on-call engineer does not acknowledge within five minutes, the alert manager escalates to the secondary on-call engineer.
